_note: Stage 1. Patterns are derived from the actual title distribution in the Naukri snapshot (see docs/stage1-data-audit.md), not guessed. `exclude` matters as much as `include`: the Indian entry-level market has a large PHP/WordPress/agency segment whose skill profile is genuinely different from product-company backend work, and pooling them produces a profile that describes neither. SENIORITY AND DESCRIPTION FILTERS ADDED after Stage 3 labelling found 7 of 40 postings (17.5%) misfiled: GIS, firmware and iOS roles as backend, three senior roles as entry-level, a business analyst as a data analyst.

exclude_description._note: Exclusions previously read only the title. Posting 18 was PHP/CakePHP/Drupal agency work titled 'Web Developer/Software Engineer' -- every disqualifying word sat in the description, so no title pattern could have caught it.

min_years_from_description._note: Naukri's structured experience field disagreed with the body text on three sampled postings -- 'Staff Software Engineer' and 'Software Engineer III' both filed as 2-5 Yrs while asking for 5+ and 7+ years. Where the description states a minimum, prefer it over the structured field.
